description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Water with Stacking], [Awoken Full Throttle Water], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Sardonic Swordfighter Mode] to the user

description.name: Awoken Full Throttle Water
description.text: Water abilities don't consume uses, cast speed x2.00/x2.25/x2.50/x2.75/x3.00 for Water abilities at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, casts Marine Sword after using two Water abilities

description.name: Marine Sword
description.text: One single attack (4.00) capped at 99999, 100% hit rate, grants [Quick Cast 1] to all allies

description.name: Attach Water with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Sardonic Swordfighter Mode
description.text: Grants [Soul Break Gauge +250] to the user after using four Water abilities, removed after triggering
